description: Rank the most-used Pokémon in a regulation by the share of ladder teams they appear on, from the most recent month of usage statistics loaded for that regulation (the month itself is not reported; get_usage_trend shows dated history). Use it to see what a team should expect to face. Mega Evolutions are ranked as separate entries.

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (1–50). Defaults to 20

name: get_top_usage

format.description: Regulation id the result applies to

title: Get the most-used Pokémon
